# Nagdev Products Private Limited

> Integrated castor oil and chemical derivatives manufacturer situated in North Gujarat's prolific castor belt (Banaskantha–Vav-Tharad region). With an integrated 50 MT/day castor seed crushing capacity, continuous chemical refining, and downstream derivatives processing, Nagdev Products manufactures technical-grade castor oils, de-oiled cake organic fertilizers, hydrogenated castor wax (HCO), and 12-hydroxystearic acid (12-HSA). The manufacturing plant is currently under installation with commercial commissioning scheduled for 2027. Nagdev Products is actively booking forward 2027 industrial supply contracts and providing technical samples and specifications for domestic and international B2B buyers.

## Company Facts & Verification
- **Legal Entity:** Nagdev Products Private Limited
- **Brand Name:** Nagdev Products
- **Manufacturing Facility:** Survey No. 301 P-2, Jada-Kotarwada Road, Village – Sardarpura, Post – Ravel, Taluka – Deodar, District – Vav-Tharad, Gujarat – 385330, India
- **Regional Geography:** Banaskantha–Vav-Tharad castor belt, North Gujarat, India
- **Crushing Capacity:** 50 MT/day seed processing
- **Commercial Commissioning:** 2027 (Now booking 2027 forward supply contracts)
- **Primary Sales Contact:** +91 63520 98306 (Voice & WhatsApp)

## Core Product Portfolio (Commissioning 2027)

1. [Commercial Grade Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/commercial-castor-oil): Standard industrial unrefined castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4) for lubricants, alkyd resins, and chemical synthesis.
2. [First Pressed Degummed Castor Oil (FPD)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/fpd-castor-oil): Virgin degummed hydraulic-pressed castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4) for high-grade industrial lubricants and chemical feedstocks.
3. [First Special Grade Castor Oil (FSG / BSS)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/first-special-grade-castor-oil): High-purity refined, bleached, and neutralized castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4) for urethanes, surfactants, and coatings.
4. [Pale Pressed Grade Castor Oil (PPG)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/ppg-castor-oil): Premium low-acid, light-colored castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4) for high-end cosmetics and specialty formulations.
5. [Cold Pressed Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/cold-pressed-castor-oil): Virgin single-press unrefined castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4) without chemical solvent extraction.
6. [Castor Oil BP 93 Grade (Pharma)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/castor-oil-bp93): Pharmacopoeia-grade refined castor oil (CAS #8001-79-4) compliant with British Pharmacopoeia monograph standards.
7. [De Oiled Cake (D.O.C) - Castor Meal](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/de-oiled-cake-castor-meal): High-nitrogen (4.0–4.5% N) organic castor fertilizer meal (CAS #68187-58-6) for sustainable soil health and crop enrichment.
8. [High Protein Castor Meal (N8 / N10)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/high-protein-castor-meal): Enriched castor protein meal (CAS #68187-58-6) delivering high nitrogen and organic matter for commercial farming.
9. [12-Hydroxystearic Acid (12-HSA)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/12-hydroxystearic-acid): Primary chemical building block (CAS #106-14-9) in flake/powder form for manufacturing lithium and complex lubricating greases.
10. [Hydrogenated Castor Oil (HCO / Castor Wax)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/hydrogenated-castor-oil): High melting point hard wax (CAS #8001-78-3) used for rheology modification, coatings, PVC lubricants, and cosmetics.
11. [Ricinoleic Acid (RA)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/ricinoleic-acid): Hydroxy fatty acid (CAS #141-22-0, 85%+ purity) for chemical synthesis, surfactants, cutting oils, and metalworking fluids.
12. [Crude Glycerin](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/crude-glycerin): Bio-based co-product (CAS #56-81-5, 80%+ glycerol content) from fatty acid splitting for industrial and chemical refining uses.
13. [Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/sodium-sulphate-anhydrous): High-purity white crystalline co-product (CAS #7757-82-6) for detergents, glass manufacturing, and textile dyeing.
14. [Refined Glycerin (USP / IP)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/refined-glycerin): 99.5% minimum purity pharmaceutical and technical grade refined glycerin (CAS #56-81-5).

---

## Specialty Range (Available on Technical Enquiry)

15. [Dehydrated Castor Oil (DCO)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dehydrated-castor-oil): Conjugated drying oil (CAS #64147-40-6) for alkyd resins, printing inks, and protective varnishes.
16. [Dehydrated Castor Oil Fatty Acid (DCO-FA)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dco-fatty-acid): High diene fatty acid (CAS #61789-45-5) for non-yellowing stoving enamels, epoxy esters, and polyamides.
17. [Blown / Oxidized Castor Oil](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/blown-oxidized-castor-oil): High-viscosity polymerized castor oil (CAS #68187-84-8) for plasticizers, lubricants, and hydraulic fluids.
18. [Bio-Polyurethane Polyols](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/bio-polyurethane-polyols): Renewable bio-based polyols derived from ricinoleic chemistry for rigid and flexible foams, sealants, and CASE systems.
19. [Sebacic Acid](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/sebacic-acid): C10 dicarboxylic acid (CAS #111-20-6) for nylon 6,10, polyamides, bio-lubricants, and plasticizers.
20. [Methyl Ricinoleate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/methyl-ricinoleate): Low-viscosity ricinoleic methyl ester (CAS #141-24-2) for plasticizers, surfactant synthesis, and cutting fluids.
21. [Methyl 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/methyl-12-hydroxystearate): Ester derivative (CAS #141-23-1) for specialty greases, waxes, and cosmetics formulations.
22. [Dioctyl Sebacate (DOS / DEHS)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dioctyl-sebacate): Low-temperature high-performance plasticizer (CAS #122-62-3 / 2432-87-3) for aerospace, PVC, and synthetic rubber.
23. [Dibutyl Sebacate (DBS)](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/dibutyl-sebacate): High-efficiency plasticizer (CAS #109-43-3) for food-contact films, specialized coatings, and polymers.
24. [Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/lithium-12-hydroxystearate): Pre-reacted soap thickener (CAS #7620-77-1) for high-temperature multi-purpose NLGI automotive and industrial greases.
25. [Calcium 12-Hydroxystearate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/calcium-12-hydroxystearate): Non-toxic metallic soap (CAS #3159-62-4) for water-resistant lubricating greases and plastics processing.
26. [Zinc Ricinoleate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/zinc-ricinoleate): Highly effective natural odor-neutralizing salt (CAS #13040-19-2) for cosmetics, detergents, and industrial deodorization.
27. [Zinc Undecylenate](https://www.nagdevproducts.com/products/zinc-undecylenate): Antifungal salt (CAS #557-08-4) for pharmaceutical powders, ointments, and personal care products.
